children: The telecom veteran brings nearly 24 years of experience across customer acquisition, operations, risk management and service processes

Vijay Savaliya has taken charge as Circle Head – Group Security and Nodal at Bharti Airtel in Gujarat, based in Ahmedabad. He assumed the role in August 2025 after spending 19 years in customer acquisition and operations at the telecom operator. His appointment marks a shift from customer lifecycle management to a leadership role covering group security and nodal responsibilities at the Gujarat circle.

Savaliya joined Bharti Airtel in September 2006 as Senior Manager – Customer Acquisition Experience. During his 19-year tenure in the position, he handled customer acquisition processes, customer lifecycle management and Telecom Enforcement, Resource and Monitoring (TERM) audits, alongside prepaid and postpaid operations.

His responsibilities covered operational processes and customer-related activities, providing him with experience across multiple aspects of telecom service delivery. He continued in the role until August 2025, when he moved to his current position as Circle Head – Group Security and Nodal.

Before joining Airtel, Savaliya worked at Tata Teleservices from September 2004 to September 2006. He held roles in customer care and installation and repair operations, including Login In-charge for South Gujarat and SMG Zonal In-charge for Saurashtra.

As Login In-charge in Surat, he led the customer care login function for South Gujarat. He subsequently moved to Rajkot, where his responsibilities included installation and repair activities as well as customer care login operations for the Saurashtra region.
These assignments gave him experience across service operations and regional telecom processes before his longer tenure at Airtel.

Savaliya began his professional career at Idea Cellular in June 2002 as an executive, working across Surat and Rajkot. His responsibilities included credit and risk management, providing an early foundation in customer-related risk assessment and operational processes.

He worked at Idea Cellular until September 2004 before moving to Tata Teleservices. His career has since spanned customer risk management, customer care, installation and repair functions, customer acquisition and telecom operations.

In his current position, Savaliya oversees Group Security and Nodal responsibilities for Airtel’s Gujarat circle. The role follows an extended career within the telecom sector, including nearly two decades at Airtel and earlier assignments at Tata Teleservices and Idea Cellular.

Savaliya holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Chemistry, which he completed between 1998 and 2001. His appointment brings extensive experience in telecom operations and regional service processes to his current leadership responsibilities in Gujarat.
